name: motu-camera-motion-reel
description: MOTU UltraLite-mk5 & 828 continuous-camera motion-graphics reel (2160x3840, 90.7s). Independent of the repository's separate 178-second project; shares the parent node_modules.

scripts.check:motion: python3 tools/motion_plan.py && node tools/motion_frames.mjs out/motionplan.json out/motion && python3 tools/motion_check.py out/motionplan.json
scripts.check:colour: node tools/colour_check.mjs e828_21j ul_03j e828_13p ul_13j e828_30j && python3 tools/colour_check.py
